author: Ari Koslow
title: Carlos Vargas (lat) expected to return in early August
desc: The Mariners expect Carlos Vargas to return in early August.
impact: Vargas began a throwing program in the middle of May. He has been dealing with a right lat strain.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cooper Criswell (shoulder) expected to return in early August
desc: The Mariners expect Cooper Criswell to return in early August.
impact: Criswell landed on the injured list last week. He will likely look to begin a rehab assignment by the middle of July.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Matt Brash (lat) expected to return in early August
desc: The Mariners expect Matt Brash to return in early August.
impact: Seattle specifically said around the trade deadline which is August 3. Brash landed back on the injured list last week with a lat injury.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cole Young hits home run Wednesday
desc: Cole Young went 1-for-4 with a home run in the Mariners 5-3 loss on Wednesday against the Orioles.
impact: Young and Dominic Canzone went back-to-back in the ninth inning for Seattle. It was the sixth home run on the year for Young.

author: Ari Koslow
title: George Kirby takes loss Wednesday
desc: George Kirby allowed three runs on eight hits over six innings with five strikeouts in a loss on Wednesday against the Orioles.
impact: Kirby posted a quality start, but he continues to struggle deep into starts. He'll figure to be in a piggyback role next time on the mound.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jackson Merrill goes deep Wednesday
desc: Jackson Merrill went 3-for-5 with a home run and two RBI in the Padres 6-1 win over the Cardinals on Wednesday.
impact: Merrill added some insurance in the ninth inning with a two-run long ball. He also added his 12th stolen base on the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Fernando Tatis Jr. collects three hits Wednesday
desc: Fernando Tatis Jr. went 3-for-5 with two RBI and a stolen base in the Padres 6-1 win over the Cardinals on Wednesday.
impact: Tatis continues his recent success to begin the month of June. He is up to 18 steals on the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Griffin Canning earns win Wednesday
desc: Griffin Canning allowed one run on four hits over 4 1/3 innings with two strikeouts and three walks in a win on Wednesday against the Cardinals.
impact: Canning pitched behind an opener in the outing. He is scheduled to face the Braves next.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Julio Rodriguez dealing with spasm in hamstring
desc: Mariners manager Dan Wilson said Julio Rodriguez has a spasm in his hamstring.
impact: It explains the early exit for Rodriguez on Wednesday. He is day-to-day heading into Thursday.

author: David Leisering
title: Corbin Carroll belts grand slam in victory Wednesday
desc: Corbin Carroll went 1-for-5 with a grand slam homer to lift the Diamondbacks to an 8-1 victory over the Angels on Wednesday.
impact: Carroll smacked his 13th home run of the season off of Sam Aldegheri with the bases loaded and two outs in the second inning to break the game open early. The outfielder is hitting just .207 (6-for-29) over his last seven games but two of those six hits have left the yard. Overall, Carroll is batting .275 with 13 home runs, 38 RBI, and nine stolen bases in 71 games this season.

author: David Leisering
title: Eduardo Rodriguez earns 100th career victory on Wednesday
desc: Eduardo Rodriguez allowed one run on six hits, walked three, and struck out five to earn his sixth win of the year in the Diamondbacks' 8-1 victory on Wednesday.
impact: Rodriguez allowed a leadoff home run to Zach Neto but then settled in and did not allow a run the rest of his outing. The victory was Rodriguez' sixth of the season and the 100th win of his career as he moved to 6-2 in 15 starts this year. The veteran lefthander lowered his ERA to 2.45 on the season - sixth best in the National League, but has struck out only 65 hitters in 88.1 innings this year. He's lined up pitch against the Cardinals in St. Louis in his next start on Tuesday.

author: David Leisering
title: Sam Aldegheri lasts only three innings Wednesday
desc: Sam Aldegheri allowed six runs on six hits, walked three, and struck out in just three innings as the Angels dropped an 8-1 decision to the Diamondbacks.
impact: The big blow against Aldegheri came in the second inning when Corbin Carroll belted a grand slam to break the game open. It was his third start of the season and it marked the first time this year he allowed more than two runs in any appearance. The lefthander has now pitched to a 6.75 ERA with a 5:8 K:BB ratio in 12 innings over his three starts while, as a reliever, he has a 1.13 ERA with an 8:3 K:BB ratio in eight frames. Should he get another shot in the rotation, Aldegheri would get the Orioles, at home, on Monday.

author: David Leisering
title: Zach Neto provides Angels' lone run Wednesday
desc: Zach Neto led off the game with a home run and finished 2-for-3 with a walk as the Angels suffered an 8-1 loss to the Diamondbacks.
impact: Neto belted his 15th home run of the season off of Arizona starter Eduardo Rodriguez but, unfortunately for the Angels, that was all they could muster offensively. Neto added a single and a walk later in the game, reaching base three times in four plate appearances. The shortstop is just 6-for-31 (.194) with 16 strikeouts over his last seven games and his season average has dipped to .228 through 72 games. While he does have 15 home runs and 11 stolen bases, Neto ranks second in the majors with 105 strikeouts in 285 at bats.
